summary: A light (#fbfbfb) marketing section, 1252x468. Top band: a thin-bordered header panel (x 116 to 1136, y 0 to 192) holds a large dark serif headline "We Made Tax / Season Simple." on two lines at left (x 165, y 50 to 145, about 46px), and at right a small grey sans paragraph "Easily manage your 1099s, W-2s, and ACA / forms in one simple, automated workflow." (x 808, y 50) above two 41px-tall buttons: a solid bright blue (#0196fc) "Try Boomtax Free" with white text and a white, faintly bordered "Book a Demo" with dark text. Below a 1px hairline at y 193, three equal step columns split by vertical hairlines at x 414 and 836. Each column holds a monochrome light-grey isometric line illustration with blue/green accents (top, y 200 to 390), then a dark serif title (~18px, y 420) and a grey sans subtitle (~14px, y 443): "Drag & Drop Your Data / We'll check to make sure there are no errors.", "Send to Recipients / We'll print, fold, stuff and mail your recipient copies.", "E-File and Done! / We'll e-file your forms in less than 15 minutes." Column 1: a tilted document with a signature, a gear tile, and two stacked document cards inside a dashed isometric outline, one with a green check ring and one with a grey check. Column 2: two envelopes wired to a round puck with a pale-green check, wired to a tall stack of tiles and two more tiles with blue document glyphs. Column 3: a grey ring with a blue balloon/tag hanging inside it, wired down and across to a white box with a yellow lightning bolt, surrounded by a green spreadsheet tile, a grey printer tile and a blue tile. The motion runs within the illustrations; the type and layout stay still. Column 1: a cursor arrow drags a 1px light-blue selection marquee with small square corner handles from the document's top-left (27,218) to its bottom-right, growing from roughly 16x16 at 0.13s to 88x124 (27..115 x 218..342) by about 1.4s. The marquee stays, and the cursor moves off to about (153,385) as a hollow arrow by 2s and is gone by 2.5s. Column 2: a short glowing green segment travels along the thin grey wire: envelope to puck around 0.1 to 0.5s, then puck onward to the stack around 2.2 to 2.5s. Column 3: a short blue segment travels along the wire from the balloon down (x≈930) and right to the box's port (≈1065,345) between 0.1s and 2s, and the balloon in the ring sways a few px around 2.5s.

criteria.check: The page background is a flat near-white (#fbfbfb), with no gradient or texture
The headline reads exactly 'We Made Tax' on line 1 and 'Season Simple.' on line 2
The headline is in a dark navy, near-black serif typeface (not sans), regular weight
The headline starts at x≈165, spans y≈50 to 145, and has a cap height of roughly 35 to 40px (font about 46px)
The paragraph reads 'Easily manage your 1099s, W-2s, and ACA' / 'forms in one simple, automated workflow.' on two lines
The paragraph is mid-grey sans-serif at about 14px, clearly lighter than the headline
The primary button is a solid bright blue (#0196fc) rectangle with near-square corners (radius ≤3px)
The primary button reads 'Try Boomtax Free' in white
The second button is white with a faint light-grey 1px border, the same height (≈41px) as the blue button, sitting ≈9px to its right
The second button reads 'Book a Demo' in dark text
Faint vertical hairlines at x≈116 and x≈1136 frame the header from the top edge down to y≈192
A 1px light-grey horizontal hairline runs across the full width at y≈193
Two vertical hairlines at x≈414 and x≈836 split the lower area into three equal columns
Column 1 title reads 'Drag & Drop Your Data' in a dark serif ~18px at x≈8, y≈420
Column 1 subtitle reads 'We'll check to make sure there are no errors.' in grey sans ~14px
Column 2 title reads 'Send to Recipients' in a dark serif starting at x≈431
Column 2 subtitle reads 'We'll print, fold, stuff and mail your recipient copies.' in grey sans
Column 3 title reads 'E-File and Done!' in a dark serif starting at x≈853
Column 3 subtitle reads 'We'll e-file your forms in less than 15 minutes.' in grey sans

Column 1 shows an original isometric line drawing: a tall tilted document with text lines and a signature, a small tile with a blue gear, and two stacked document cards inside a dashed isometric outline, in light grey with soft shading
The upper-right doc card carries a bright green check inside a green ring; the lower-left card's check and ring are pale grey
The outline that encloses the two doc cards is dashed grey (not solid)

Column 2 shows an original isometric drawing of two grey envelopes, a round puck with a pale green check, a tall stack of tiles and two more tiles, each tile topped by a blue document glyph, joined by thin grey wires
Exactly 3 blue-topped document tiles or stacks appear (one tall stack plus two single tiles)

Column 3 shows an original isometric drawing of a grey ring with a blue tag hanging inside, a green spreadsheet tile, a grey printer tile, a white box with a yellow lightning bolt and a blue tile, joined by a thin wire
The bolt on the white box is yellow/amber, and the box is white with soft grey isometric side faces, not outlined in black
The marquee is a thin (≈1px) light-blue outline with no fill, with a small square handle at each of its 4 corners
At rest the marquee spans x≈27 to 115 and y≈218 to 342, enclosing the whole document
The marquee grows from a small box (≈16x16 at the top-left corner 27,218) at 0.13s to about 46x62 at 0.5s; its top-left corner stays fixed
Between 0.5s and 1.38s the marquee's bottom-right corner moves from ≈(73,280) to ≈(115,342), and it is fully grown by about 1.4s
The marquee does not change between 2s and 2.5s; it stays drawn and is not removed
A white arrow pointer with a dark outline sits at the marquee's growing bottom-right corner (≈112,338 at 1s)
After the drag, the cursor moves down-right off the document to ≈(153,385) by 2s, where it shows as a hollow outlined arrow, and it is gone by 2.5s
At 0.13s a short bright green stretch lights the wire between the envelope and the puck (≈555 to 600, y≈320); the rest of the wire is grey
The pulse is a soft glowing green stretch of the wire itself, not a separate dot or arrow, and it fades at both ends
Between 2s and 2.5s a green stretch appears on the wire beyond the puck, toward the tile stack (≈640 to 690, y 290 to 315); at 2s that wire is all grey
At 0.13s a blue stretch lights the vertical wire below the ring's tag (x≈930, y≈290 to 345)
The blue stretch travels along the wire: near (985,378) at 0.5s, then right and up to ≈(1045,355) by 1.38s
By 2s the blue stretch reaches the box's port (≈1065,345), and by 2.5s the wire is grey again
The blue tag inside the ring sways slightly (a few px tilt/shift) between 2s and 2.5s, while the ring itself stays put
No text, button or divider line moves at any time: header and column labels are identical at 0.13s and 2.5s
The document, gear tile and doc cards in column 1 do not move while the marquee is dragged
